complete_pair_palette_control.completeness_argument: A facet of P_t-P_u exposes a sum of two faces with total affine span dimension2. If one exposed face has dimension2, its normal is a face normal of one owner. Otherwise both exposed faces are edges with independent directions, and the facet normal is their cross product. These actual edges, both exact owner frames, all face normals and every edge cross product were enumerated; zero products excluded exactly. The retained normals are precisely candidates exposing a two-dimensional sum face for at least one pair. Hence every pair-difference-body facet direction is retained.

shear_contact_control.tail_rule: Write u=m-n, v=m+n. For 0<=t<=T<=H/2, x(t)>R/2 and y(t)>R. Thus |u|>=5 or |v|>=3 gives horizontal distance>2R, separating the enclosing cylinders. Otherwise |u|<=4, |v|<=2; if |l|>=4 then |l H+u t|>=2H>H, so complete vertical intervals separate. All remaining nonzero words of matching u,v parity and |l|<=3 are checked with one common actual facet at both endpoints. Its gap is affine, hence nonnegative throughout the path.
shear_contact_control.scope: A complete continuous fixed-two-frame infinite source path with parity m+n+l modulo2, not arbitrary-frame or density optimality.

All vertical copies are included in the exact source path and rational short-word/tail checks. Each column alternates with l.
